name: India

nationalGame.name: Field Hockey
nationalGame.about: India's hockey wizards have won 8 Olympic gold medals — the most in the world.
nationalGame.note: India has no official national game — field hockey is the most famous one.

loved.name: Cricket
loved.why: Streets go quiet when India plays — the whole country watches together.

loved.name: Kabaddi
loved.why: Born here! Millions now watch the big Pro Kabaddi league on TV.

loved.name: Badminton
loved.why: Indian champs fill stadiums and win world titles.

fact: Chess was invented in India over 1,500 years ago — the original game was called chaturanga.
